name: Triple Milk Deep Hydrating Body wash
subtitle: For dry, dehydrated skin
keyIngredients: Triple Milk Blend (Shea, Coconut & Oat Milk Extracts)
usageInstructions: Apply a generous amount of body wash to your palms or loofah. Massage onto wet skin in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly
description: Dryness that just won’t quit? Meet Be Bodywise’s Triple Milk Deep Hydrating Body Wash for dry, tight skin. ✨ What makes it different? 🔹 6% Triple Milk: A blend of Shea, Coconut & Oat Milk to soothe dryness and leave your skin feeling calm. 🔹 3% Hydration Boosters: To lock in moisture & prevent dehydration. 🔹 0.8% Dual Action Beads: Glycerin & Hyaluronic Acid beads that provide instant moisture for smooth, hydrated skin.
usage: Step 1: Take an adequate amount into your palms or loofah. Step 2: Apply on wet skin in a circular motion. Step 3: Rinse thoroughly & pat dry.

list.title: Can I use this product everyday?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using this body wash for all skin types once a day, every day.

list.title: Is this suitable for my skin type?
list.content: Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types, especially dry skin types.

list.title: How much time will it take to see results?
list.content: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition, however you should start noticing a change within 3 months.

list.title: Can I use this product on my face?
list.content: This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial moisturisation.

list.title: What are the benefits of this body wash?
list.content: This body wash deeply hydrates, soothes, and softens dry skin with its Triple Milk blend and moisture-infused beads - leaving your skin nourished, supple, and comfortable long after you shower.
